Create ScMaSigPro Object

Source: R/create_scmp.R
create_scmp.Rd

create_scmp() initializes a ScMaSigPro object with the given counts, cell level metadata, and other optional parameters.

create_scmp(
  counts,
  cell_data,
  feature_data = NULL,
  bin_counts = NULL,
  bin_cell_data = NULL,
  ptime_col,
  path_col,
  use_as_bin = FALSE
)

Arguments

counts

A matrix containing the raw expression counts.

cell_data

A data frame containing the cell level metadata.

feature_data

Optional data frame of gene metadata, one row per gene of counts (named like them, or with automatic row names). It becomes the rowData() of the Sparse slot, and of the Dense slot when this function builds it.

bin_counts

Optional pseudo-bulk counts of bins made outside scMaSigPro: a matrix with the genes of counts as rows, in the same order, and one column per bin. Requires bin_cell_data; not with use_as_bin = TRUE.

bin_cell_data

A data frame with one row per bin, named like the columns of bin_counts, holding the binned pseudotime in ptime_col and the path in path_col. A scmp_bin_size column gives the number of cells of each bin; without it the sizes are NA.

ptime_col

A character string representing the column name for inferred Pseudotime values. (Default is "Pseudotime")

path_col

A character string representing the column name for branching path assignment. (Default is path_prefix)

use_as_bin

A logical indicating to run MaSigPro analysis without pseudotime binning. Defaults to FALSE.

Value

An object of class ScMaSigPro, with aligned pseudotime.

Details

The Dense slot holds the bins. By default it is empty and sc.squeeze() bins the cells. With use_as_bin = TRUE every cell is a bin. With bin_counts and bin_cell_data it holds bins made outside scMaSigPro, and the workflow continues with sc.set.poly(); such bins have no member cells, so pb_counts() and sc.restruct() do not apply.
